turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John! Long time no see! What's up?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria! Good to see you. Just got back from a family road trip yesterday, it was fun! Anything exciting happening for you?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Been busy volunteering at the homeless shelter and keeping fit. Just started doing aerial yoga, it's great. Have you tried any other cool workout classes?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Woah, Maria, that sounds cool! I'm doing kickboxing and it's giving me so much energy.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Cool, John. Kickboxing is a perfect way to stay in shape and de-stress. Do you have any goals you're working towards?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah Maria, I'm really hoping to get into local politics. I love helping the community and making it a better place.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Woohoo, John! That's awesome! Any specific areas you want to tackle?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I'm passionate about improving education and infrastructure in our community. Those are my main focuses.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John! It's great to hear that. Could you tell me what got you interested in those topics?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Growing up, I saw how lack of education and crumbling infrastructure affected my neighborhood. I don't want future generations to go through that, so I think schools and infrastructure should be funded properly. Here's a pic of a school last year, after they got the funding.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Looks good! How did the extra funding help with building the school?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: It enabled needed repairs and renovations, making the learning environment safer and more modern for students.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow John, it really made a difference for schools and students! It must have been great to be involved. What's your next move in politics?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I'm gonna chat with local leaders and organizations, get support and gather ideas for my next move.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Sounds good, John. Let's get support and great ideas from local leaders and organizations. Keep me posted on how your campaign is going.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Got it! Thanks, Maria. I definitely will.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, been a few days since we chatted. In the meantime, I donated my old car to a homeless shelter I volunteer at yesterday. How's the campaign going? I'm keen to hearabout it.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hi Maria! It's been an interesting ride so far. I've been networking with some people to get their input.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That's awesome, John! Networking is great for gaining new perspectives and insights. Have you had any interesting conversations or revelations so far?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I just talked to someone who shared some amazing stories. It really fired up my passion to make education better in our area.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John! Hearing that can really make an impact and get us fired up to make a difference. It's great to hear that you're feeling motivated to make improvements to our community's education!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Definitely, Maria. Investing in our future generations is key, giving them the right tools for success. It's the foundation of progress and opportunity.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, John. It's amazing how even minor tweaks to the system can make a big difference for lots of people. I'm really impressed with your enthusiasm and commitment to it!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria. Your encouragement means a lot to me. It's true that with effort and support, we can make a real difference in our community.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: You got this, John! I believe in your power to make a positive difference. Your passion inspires me. Keep going - I'm here for you.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks a lot, Maria. Your help is really motivating and makes me more determined. Here's a pic of my family - they're the reason why I never give up. Their love gives me strength.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John, that's a great pic! Your family looks so cheerful and loving. It's wonderful to have such a supportive and loving family.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria. They really help me stay centered. They remind me why I'm so passionate about making a positive impact.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Family's love really grounds us and gives us strength. Their support certainly boosts your motivation.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, they are my rock in tough times and always cheer me on. I'm really thankful for their love. Family time means a lot to me.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John, that playground looks cool! What kind of stuff do you and your family do there?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! We love climbing, sliding, and playing games. It's an awesome way to connect and have a blast. What do you enjoy doing with your family?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: My fam's small, but I love spending time with the friends I have. We usually watch movies, hike, and have game nights at my place. Quality connections matter most to me.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Sounds nice, Maria! Spending time with loved ones is important.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Definitely, John. They bring us joy, support, and a feeling of being part of something special. We should cherish every moment with them.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah Maria, making memories with family is priceless! Life is so much more meaningful when we spend time together. Here's a pic of us at dinner.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Woah, that's a nice pic, John! You all obviously had a blast at dinner. Nothing beats getting together with loved ones for a good meal - it makes some awesome memories!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! Meal times are always fun. Good food, laughs, and chats help us stay close.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, John! It definitely builds a strong bond. Those shared meals really make life enjoyable and meaningful. What did you make?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: We made pizza! We had so much fun making them together. It was great picking out toppings and sharing a tasty meal with family. Have you made anything lately?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: I can picture you all laughing and having a blast making your own pizzas - a great way to bond! I made some peach cobbler recently, it was great.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah Maria, it's awesome! We get our creative on and have a blast together.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Sure, John! It's those moments of creativity and laughter that bring us closer. Let's make happy memories with our family and keep them close.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yep, let's keep making great memories with our loved ones and cherishing the time we have. I'm off to do some taekwondo!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria, great to chat again! I joined a service-focused online group last week and it's been an emotional ride. Everyone there is incredible with their own inspiring stories. They've opened my eyes to new perspectives, and I'm feeling a sense of connection and purpose with them.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John! That's amazing news. It's great to see you finding such a supportive community that is making a difference.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! It's great to have a group of people with the same passion for serving. It's been really inspiring sharing stories, advice, and encouragement.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That's great to hear! It's always inspiring to share thos things with like-minded individuals. By the way, have you had the chance to meet any of them in person?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: We held some events and got to meet some people. We went to a homeless shelter to give out food and supplies. Seeing the smiles on their faces, we knew we made a real difference. We also organized a toy drive for kids in need. It was amazing seeing the community come together to spread some joy.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That sounds great, John. It's nice to see the difference you're making. Do you have any ideas for future projects?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: We're brainstorming some to help underserved communities get access to education, mentorship, job training, and resume building. The goal is to empower individuals in achieving their aspirations.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That's great, John! Empowering individuals through education and mentorship is crucial for helping them reach their goals. Can't wait to see the initiatives you come up with!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! I'm really excited about them too. I believe that providing the right assistance and resources can make a lasting impact.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yep John, a bit of support can make an amazing change. You're spot on about it, it really is powerful. Keep doing what you're doing, it's really inspiring!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! I really appreciate your support, It means a lot to me. Especially after I failed the military aptitude test recently, I've been feeling a bit stressed out.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: No worries, John. I'm here for you and I got your back. Nature's beauty reminds me to slow down and enjoy the small stuff.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That's a chill pic! Where did you find it?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: I took it at the beach last month. Watching the sunset was so peaceful, it made me feel connected to nature and appreciate life's small moments.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, nature can be so beautiful! It reminds me of the film camera I had as a kid, I took plenty of beach pics. Thanks for sharing.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Glad you enjoyed it, John! It's amazing how beautiful it can be.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, it does. It helps us remember the small joys, especially when life gets busy.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, great news - I'm now friends with one of my fellow volunteers! We both love helping others. How have you been since we last chatted?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria, I've been busy with work and family, but last week I had an unexpected incident on my way home. It reminded me how life can throw unexpected troubles our way.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Oh John, that sounds tough. I'm glad you're alright. Life does throw us some surprises, doesn't it?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria. This is a reminder to stay strong during tough times.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah John, when stuff like that happens, it's good to tap into our own inner strength. How did you handle it?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I tried to stay calm and asked for assistance, which helped me handle the situation and make it back safely.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey, John that's awesome! You really showed your resilience and resourcefulness. How did you feel afterwards?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I felt relieved and grateful to make it through without incident.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, it's tough. Appreciate what you've got. You got through it - stay strong. Are there any things you like to do to calm down during times like this?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! I like to just take a look at the sunset- it reminds me to enjoy the small things in life.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: It's great to hear that you appreciate the beauty of sunsets! By the way, have there been any developments regarding your political goals?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I've been keeping busy since we last talked! I've been looking into local politics, talking to community leaders, and getting to know the needs and hopes of our neighborhood. It's been super informative, and I'm feeling optimistic about it all.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John! Your dedication to our community is amazing. Keep up the great work! I've been taking some notes about local politics in my notebook.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! You're super helpful. That gives me some new ideas and plans for our community!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Glad I could help, John. What's up next for you?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Next week I have a community meeting coming up, we'll be discussing education and infrastructure upgrades.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Good luck on that! Hope your ideas and concerns get heard.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! I'm hoping so. I'll definitely stick up for our community. Discussing it is important.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Definitely, John! Talking and working together will make a great difference. You're really doing our community a service by speaking out. It's admirable and inspiring.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Maria, thank you! Your support means a lot. Let's make some change in our community!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, let's do it, John! Working together, we can bring positive changes to the neighborhood as a team.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, Maria! We can achieve great things if we join forces together.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Agreed, John! Uniting is essential for making a difference. if we stand together we can tackle any problems and build a great community.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, Maria! I couldn't agree more. Thanks for being an awesome friend.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: No worries, John. It's really nice to help. We make a great team.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yup, we rock as a team! Glad to have you.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria, since we last spoke I went to that community mtg. It was really interesting hearing everyone's worries and how it affects our area. It made me realize how crucial the upgrades are, especially for the kids. I'm really upset seeing the state of our education. How do you think we can make things better?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, cool that you made it. You're right, it's really sad to see the state of education. We should fight for more money and resources for schools and raise awareness about the importance of education. It's not just for our kids, but for all of us too!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yup, education is essential for a successful society. I totally agree that we should fight for more money and resources for our schools. It breaks my heart that our kids don't have the proper stuff they need. They deserve better.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, John. Our kids are our future; they should have the best. It kills me to think about all the kids without the proper stuff they need. It's just not right.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: It's definitely isn't, Maria. My kids have so much and others don't. We really need to do something about it.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Sure, it's not right that some kids get all they need while others have nothing to help them succeed. We gotta do something! Last week I volunteered at a shelter during an event for kids, and it's been a great experience.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria! That's really making a big impact. What made you decide to get involved with that?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: I started volunteering to help make a difference. My aunt believed in volunteering, and used to help my family out when we were struggling, so I'm inspired by her. It makes me happy knowing I can brighten somebody's day.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria. That's amazing! I can imagine it's incredibly rewarding. Is there a particular moment that stands out to you as the most impactful?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: For me, it was when I noticed a little girl around 8 sitting all alone. She seemed so sad. So, I sat with her and we talked. Turns out she had no other family - it broke my heart. I was able to give her some comfort and a listening ear. We ended up laughing and having a good time.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, what a touching moment, Maria. I'm glad you were there for her when she needed someone. I'm sure it made a big impact.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That's nice of you, John. What's the photo about?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: It reminds me of something from my childhood. I had a little doll like this and it always made me feel better. It reminds me to always look out for others, especially when they're feeling down.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That's sweet. Spreading kindness and support can really make a difference, especially when someone is feeling down. Thanks for sharing.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: No problem, Maria. It's important to support each other when we're feeling down. You never know the difference a kind gesture can make.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yep, kindness is key and a little compassion can really turn someone's day around. So glad we're on the same page here.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John! Long time no talk. I just wanted to let you know I challenged myself last Friday and did a charity event. It was great! I truly felt the power of our collective effort to help people in need, so heartwarming.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria! Truly inspiring! It's so cool to see how our community can make a difference. How did it feel to be part of that event?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! It was such a rewarding experience. Just the act of serving meals and seeing the gratitude on their faces was truly heartwarming. It reminded me of how powerful compassion can be. So, tell me, what made you get into politics?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I feel a strong urge to serve my country and community. Running for office was my chance to make an impact. But anyway, tell me more about your charity event. Did something special happen that made it meaningful for you?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, at the event, I had a conversation with someone named David. Hearing his story of hardship and how he ended up in difficult circumstances was so humbling. It just showed me that everyone has their own story and deserves understanding.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, that's powerful. It just shows that everyone has their own story and deserves understanding. Do you know any organizations or services that could help him out?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, I did. I talked to him afterwards and linked him up with a nearby organization that offers housing and support for homeless individuals. Hopefully, he'll find the help he needs.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Nice job, Maria! You really made an impact. It's important to help people find what they need. Have you ever been in a situation where you needed help?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John. When I was younger, we had some money problems and had to rely on outside help from out auntie. It was a tough learning experience about the importance of helping others who struggle.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, Maria, we learn a lot from our own struggles. I just started helping out with a food drive for folks who lost their jobs. Here's a picture of me at the food bank.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John, that's incredible! What inspired you to get involved with something like this?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Seeing the effect unemployment has on our neighbors made me decide to act. I wanted to help out in these tough times by doing a community food drive. We can all make a difference!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That's really great of you. What sparked your decision to start this initiative?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria. Unemployment in our community was the reason behind it.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: You did awesome! How's the response been to that?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! We've been overwhelmed by the response and the volunteers. Here's a photo of them at a recent event.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Seeing so many people support the community is awesome. I'd love to lend a hand with networking or helping out at future events.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That'd be great, Maria! Thanks for offering to help. Your assistance would be really appreciated.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: No worries, John. Whenever you need help, just let me know.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yep, definitely. Your support really means a lot, Maria. Thanks for always being there for me.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Of course, John. You're a great friend to me. I'll always be there for you.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria. Friendship means a lot to me. I'm glad we have each other's backs and can work towards a shared goal.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, how's it going? Just wanted to give you the heads up on what's been happening lately- I took a creative writing class recently, and it was super enlightening!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria! Wanted to let you know that I'm running for office again. It's been a wild ride, but I'm more excited than ever! How have you been?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Congrats, John! What made you decide to run again? As for me, I've been volunteering at a homeless shelter and it's really rewarding.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! After my last run, I saw the impact I could make in the community through politics. It's rewarding to work towards positive changes and a better future.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow John, your enthusiasm for making a better future is inspiring. Making a positive impact is so rewarding! While volunteering yesterday, I met this amazing woman, Jean, who had been through a lot, yet stayed optimistic and resilient. She showed me the importance of gratitude and connection.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria! How did she end up in such a situation, and how did she remain positive throughout?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: She had a tough time, going through a divorce, losing her job, and ending up homeless. Yet, she still values the little things and believes in the good of kindness.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: It's really inspiring to see someone staying optimistic even when things get tough.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, sure is. It's a reminder that, no matter what, we can still find joy and hope.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Keep up the great work, Maria! It's important to stay positive and thankful, even when life's tough. A little kindness and optimism can go a long way. Sounds like your volunteer work has been very influential - amazing!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! Your words mean a lot. It's incredible how much positivity and optimism can impact someone.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yep. It's moments like these that remind me of how important it is to be kind and optimistic.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Sure thing, John. Those things can really make a difference. Let's keep spreading positivity and making an impact together.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I totally agree, Maria! Let's keep helping each other and make the world a better place.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Sounds cool, John! Let's make some positive change and brighten up that place. Do you have anything fun coming up soon?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Let's do it, Maria! Together, we can make a real difference and bring a brighter future. And nothing too soon, but my colleague Rob invited me to a beginner's yoga class.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Sounds fun! I hope you have a good time. In the meantime, let's work together to make things better for our community.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, I haven't talked to you in a while. Last week, my grandma passed away and it's been really hard. I'm trying to stay positive, but it's tough. How're you doing?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: So sorry to hear about your loss, Maria. I'm here for you if you need anything. I'm doing well, I just had a picnic with the wife and kids.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks for your support, John. How's your family doing? That baby in the pic is adorable! What's their name?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! They're doing great. Our one-year-old is so cute, his name is Kyle!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Sounds like parenting has been a wonderful experience for you - what has it been like?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: It's definitely been a wild ride! It's full of ups and downs, but the love and happiness outweigh it all.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Parenting can be tough but rewarding. Do you take your kid to the park often?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, we go a few times a week. It's great for family bonding and letting the kids run around. We had a great time last weekend - they really enjoyed the carefree joy.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Looks like a blast! Did everyone get a chance to try it? Glad you're all having a great time!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, everyone got a chance to swing. It's always fun coming up with activities for my family to enjoy.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John, that's amazing! How do you come up with these ideas?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: I just try to find things that we'll have fun with, like a walk or picnic in the park, or finding events in our town and beyond. Just last week, I found a violin concert that we all enjoyed. It's all about making memories together.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John, that's great! Making memories together is so valuable. I loved doing something similar with my siblings when I was young - it's amazing how something so simple can make such lasting memories.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That pic is so cool! It looks like something from a storybook. What gave you the idea for this?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! I got the idea from that trip to England a few years ago - I was mesmerized by the castles. I wanted to bring that same magic to my home, like a reminder of the world's beauty. I made a painting too!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, that looks great! Where in England was it?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: It was in London. The architecture there was so captivating that I wanted to recreate some of that charm in my own space. It's a reminder of London's history and grace.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, having symbols of travel memories in our homes is so cool! Last week I retook the aptitude test with some great results, and I feel drawn to serving my country in this way.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, that's really cool! Have you discussed it with anyone yet?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, I chatted with my family and friends about it. They've been supportive and understand why I want to volunteer. I'm really proud to have this opportunity!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Glad you have a good support system, John. It's been great having people behind me while volunteering at the homeless shelter. Positive influences make a big impact.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Cool, Maria! You've built some awesome connections and you're making a big impact at the homeless shelter - nice work! How did you manage to do that?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! It took time and effort, but I slowly formed connections by listening and showing compassion. It's all about building trust and forming real relationships.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria! I see, so that's the key to making a difference.

turns.speaker: Maria

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, how're you doing? I'm sorry about Max. Losing a pet is tough. Some friends from church and I went camping last weekend - it was a blast! Just something nice to take my mind off things. Anything fun in your life lately?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria, thanks for your kind words. It's still tough, but I'm finding some comfort in the good memories. Wow, your camping trip sounds awesome! I went on a mountaineering trip last week with some workmates. It was great and helped clear my head. Anything else cool happening in your life?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Glad you're finding comfort, John. That mountaineering trip sounds amazing. Did you reach the summit? When I was younger, my family and I went on a road trip to Oregon.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! Yeah, we made it to the top and the view was stunning. It was tough but awesome. Your family trip must have been great too, right? What was the prettiest spot?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hiking to the top and seeing this was awesome! Breath-taking.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria! That waterfall and bridge look amazing! What a view. How was it being there?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: I felt like I was in a fairy tale! The water sounded so calming and the surroundings were beautiful. It was truly magical!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria, that sounds awesome! It seems like nature has a way of calming us down, huh?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, it's like a natural soul-soother when things get tough.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, for sure. It's like a reset button, you know? Have you ever gone camping or mountain climbing before?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: I've gone camping a few times but never tried mountain climbing. Sounds thrilling though! Have you been camping before?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, plenty of times. It's an awesome way to get away from it all and be at one with nature. I love how uncomplicated it is.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah John, I get it. Being in nature helps us take a break from life's craziness and recognize what truly matters.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, Maria. It's important to appreciate the small things and find moments of peace amidst chaos. Nature really helps with that. How about you? How do you find peaceful moments?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Finding my Zen is a mix of things - a moment to myself plus favorite tunes is usually enough. I also enjoy aerial yoga, it's a great way to switch off and focus on my body.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Cool, Maria! Glad you found something that gives you some peace. Do you have a favorite yoga pose?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! It's tough to pick just one, but I really enjoy the upside-down poses. They make me feel free and light.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria, that sounds awesome! I can imagine that must be challenging, but it's great to see you embracing them. Keep up the amazing work!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! It can be tough, but aerial yoga is totally worth it. I love the freedom and connection it brings. Appreciate your support!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yes, Maria! I'm here for you. Glad you found something that makes you happy. This is what makes me smile. Keep shining!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow! Looks like you had fun - what happened there?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: It was an awesome day at the park with my family. The kids had a lot of fun on the playground, and we had some really nice family time.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, that's great to hear, John! Cherish those family time moments!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, been good since we talked? I got some great news to share - I joined a gym last week! It's been super positive - I'm sticking to my workout routine and the people are awesome. The atmosphere is so welcoming.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Congrats, Maria! Sounds like it's been a great experience. Having a positive environment and supportive people can really help with motivation, right? So, do you have any fitness goals in mind?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! Yeah, it's been awesome. I want to get stronger and improve my endurance, and I'm trying kundalini yoga. What about you? Do you have any goals or activities you want to try?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Nice one, Maria! Staying in shape is important to me too. I'm trying out different workout regimes lately. Rock climbing sounds like a fun way to push my limits, have you ever given it a go?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: No, I haven't tried it yet. But it sounds like a great way to push yourself. Let me know how it goes if you give it a shot!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, sure thing. I'll let you know. Oh, also...something massive happened since we last spoke. I got promoted at work! It's been a loooong time coming, and I'm over the moon about it!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow John! Congrats on the promotion! Must have taken a lot of work. How did you feel when you found out?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! I was really excited. It feels like all the hard work I've put in has paid off now that I'm an assistant manager- it's like a stepping stone for bigger things.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John! Congrats on the promotion! What's the backstory on that trophy?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! It commemorates my journey. It's a symbol of all the obstacles I had to overcome to get here.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Cool, so you have a reminder of all that. It's good to acknowledge what you've been through and appreciate where you are now. Could you tell me more about the challenges?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, I faced all kinds of hurdles - tech stuff, workplace stuff... but the worst was self-doubt. There were moments when I questioned if I was on the right track. But with support at home and my own grit, I powered through. This promotion is a reward for all the hustle and hardship I put in - a reminder that I'm on the right path.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John, it's incredible to see how far you've come! Your perseverance and determination is so inspiring. I can imagine those hurdles were tough to deal with, especially the self-doubt.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! It wasn't easy, but I'm proud of what I achieved. It can be tricky, but having support and believing in myself really helped me out.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah John, having belief in yourself matters. Plus it helps a lot when you've got loved ones supporting you. What we can do is seriously incredible with the right people believing in us.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Definitely, Maria. Support from loved ones is vital. With their trust, we can do anything! I'm really lucky to have my family on this journey with me.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Nice workspace! When do you usually work?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! I usually work during regular work hours, but sometimes I bring work home too.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: That work setup looks nice, John. How do you manage to balance everything?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! It can be challenging, so I try to organize my time and make sure I'm there for the important things. It's all about finding that balance and making those moments count!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Finding balance is crucial. Taking time for ourselves and the important people in our lives is vital.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yeah, Maria. Taking time off for ourselves and our fam is so important. It helps us stay connected and appreciate the simple things. That beach pic you shared reminded me of a special vacation we had to California- a gorgeous sunset and an awesome night strolling the shore, creating memories together. Do you have any special beach memories you'd like to share?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Yeah, John! I have a picture from a vacation in Florida. The colors were amazing, and I had a feeling of gratitude just sitting there with my family. It's in moments like these we make the best memories, ya know?

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria! That photo is so stunning. The colors there are so vivid - it must have been amazing! Trips like these are great - always full of amazing memories! Here's one from our vacation!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John. That picture is so cute! The kids look so happy splashing in the waves. It must have been such a joyful and carefree time!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Yep, it was amazing. Enjoying these special family times is why life is great. Talk to you soon!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, long time no talk! A lot has happened since then. I've been struggling, but I'm focusing on the positive and relying on my friends and fam for support.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria, sorry to hear that. That's rough, but it's great that you're focusing on the positive. Having support from your loved ones can make a big difference. How have they been helping you out?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, thanks. My family has been there for me all the way. They've been my rock, giving me words of encouragement and reminding me I'm not alone. It's a relief to have their support.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That's great, Maria! It's such a blessing to have family who always supports us and reminds us that we're not alone. They know us like no one else and stick by us no matter what. Last week, we had a blast at a live music event. Seeing them dancing and having fun was awesome. The energy in the air was amazing.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Wow, John! The energy from the crowd must have unreal! So glad you and your family got to experience that lively event. These are the moments that make the best memories.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Thanks, Maria! It was definitely an amazing experience. Moments like these remind me to appreciate the ones I love. Life can be tough, but finding silver linings helps me keep going. How have you been finding silver linings in tough times?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Volunteering at the shelter made me feel great to help, even if just for a bit.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Wow, Maria! That's really amazing. It must have felt great to help out. Do you have any special memories from your experience?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: There are so many, but one that stands out was when I met someone special at the shelter. They'd been sad for months, but when I was playing with the kids, they suddenly laughed - it was so uplifting! I won't forget that.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That's a really nice memory, Maria! It's amazing how just playing with kids can bring such joy and happiness. It shows how even a brief moment with someone can make a difference. Thanks for sharing it with me.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: No problem, John! It was really nice. Being able to make a difference brings me joy.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: It's great knowing that our actions can brighten someone else's life. Keep it up!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! Gonna continue doing it - it's my way of spreading kindness and positivity.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Maria, that's great! Your way of passing on kindness and positivity is making a big impact on the world. You're really making a difference.

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! Your words really mean a lot. It's always nice to know that what I'm doing is making an impact.

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: You definitely are. Keep going with it!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Thanks, John! I definitely will. Speak to you soon!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That's awesome, Maria! Keep that positivity going and keep making a difference. Take care!

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John, long time no see! Sorry I didn't get back to you sooner... So much has happened! Check out these kids I met at the shelter!

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: Hey Maria! Good to hear from you. Those little ones are adorable, any updates on them? How have you been?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: Hey John! They were great, their smiles warmed my heart. But something not so great happened yesterday...

turns.speaker: John
turns.text: That's so sad. Can I do anything to help? What happened?

turns.speaker: Maria
turns.text: A car ran a red light and hit us, but thankfully everyone is okay. Besides that, my cousin just had a tough time recently, so I'm lending a hand in helping her find a new place.

turns.speaker: John

[D18:1] Maria: Hey John, how're you doing? I'm sorry about Max. Losing a pet is tough. Some friends from church and I went camping last weekend - it was a blast! Just something nice to take my mind off things. Anything fun in your life lately?
[D18:2] John: Hey Maria, thanks for your kind words. It's still tough, but I'm finding some comfort in the good memories. Wow, your camping trip sounds awesome! I went on a mountaineering trip last week with some workmates. It was great and helped clear my head. Anything else cool happening in your life?
[D18:3] Maria: Glad you're finding comfort, John. That mountaineering trip sounds amazing. Did you reach the summit? When I was younger, my family and I went on a road trip to Oregon.
[D18:4] John: Thanks, Maria! Yeah, we made it to the top and the view was stunning. It was tough but awesome. Your family trip must have been great too, right? What was the prettiest spot?
[D18:5] Maria: Hiking to the top and seeing this was awesome! Breath-taking.
[D18:6] John: Wow, Maria! That waterfall and bridge look amazing! What a view. How was it being there?
[D18:7] Maria: I felt like I was in a fairy tale! The water sounded so calming and the surroundings were beautiful. It was truly magical!
[D18:8] John: Wow, Maria, that sounds awesome! It seems like nature has a way of calming us down, huh?
[D18:9] Maria: Yeah, it's like a natural soul-soother when things get tough.
[D18:10] John: Yeah, for sure. It's like a reset button, you know? Have you ever gone camping or mountain climbing before?
[D18:11] Maria: I've gone camping a few times but never tried mountain climbing. Sounds thrilling though! Have you been camping before?
[D18:12] John: Yeah, plenty of times. It's an awesome way to get away from it all and be at one with nature. I love how uncomplicated it is.
[D18:13] Maria: Yeah John, I get it. Being in nature helps us take a break from life's craziness and recognize what truly matters.
[D18:14] John: Yeah, Maria. It's important to appreciate the small things and find moments of peace amidst chaos. Nature really helps with that. How about you? How do you find peaceful moments?
[D18:15] Maria: Finding my Zen is a mix of things - a moment to myself plus favorite tunes is usually enough. I also enjoy aerial yoga, it's a great way to switch off and focus on my body.
[D18:16] John: Cool, Maria! Glad you found something that gives you some peace. Do you have a favorite yoga pose?
[D18:17] Maria: Thanks, John! It's tough to pick just one, but I really enjoy the upside-down poses. They make me feel free and light.
[D18:18] John: Wow, Maria, that sounds awesome! I can imagine that must be challenging, but it's great to see you embracing them. Keep up the amazing work!
[D18:19] Maria: Thanks, John! It can be tough, but aerial yoga is totally worth it. I love the freedom and connection it brings. Appreciate your support!
[D18:20] John: Yes, Maria! I'm here for you. Glad you found something that makes you happy. This is what makes me smile. Keep shining!
[D18:21] Maria: Wow! Looks like you had fun - what happened there?
[D18:22] John: It was an awesome day at the park with my family. The kids had a lot of fun on the playground, and we had some really nice family time.
[D18:23] Maria: Wow, that's great to hear, John! Cherish those family time moments!
[D19:1] Maria: Hey John, been good since we talked? I got some great news to share - I joined a gym last week! It's been super positive - I'm sticking to my workout routine and the people are awesome. The atmosphere is so welcoming.
[D19:2] John: Congrats, Maria! Sounds like it's been a great experience. Having a positive environment and supportive people can really help with motivation, right? So, do you have any fitness goals in mind?
[D19:3] Maria: Thanks, John! Yeah, it's been awesome. I want to get stronger and improve my endurance, and I'm trying kundalini yoga. What about you? Do you have any goals or activities you want to try?
[D19:4] John: Nice one, Maria! Staying in shape is important to me too. I'm trying out different workout regimes lately. Rock climbing sounds like a fun way to push my limits, have you ever given it a go?
[D19:5] Maria: No, I haven't tried it yet. But it sounds like a great way to push yourself. Let me know how it goes if you give it a shot!
[D19:6] John: Yeah, sure thing. I'll let you know. Oh, also...something massive happened since we last spoke. I got promoted at work! It's been a loooong time coming, and I'm over the moon about it!
[D19:7] Maria: Wow John! Congrats on the promotion! Must have taken a lot of work. How did you feel when you found out?
[D19:8] John: Thanks, Maria! I was really excited. It feels like all the hard work I've put in has paid off now that I'm an assistant manager- it's like a stepping stone for bigger things.
[D19:9] Maria: Wow, John! Congrats on the promotion! What's the backstory on that trophy?
[D19:10] John: Thanks, Maria! It commemorates my journey. It's a symbol of all the obstacles I had to overcome to get here.
[D19:11] Maria: Cool, so you have a reminder of all that. It's good to acknowledge what you've been through and appreciate where you are now. Could you tell me more about the challenges?
[D19:12] John: Yeah, I faced all kinds of hurdles - tech stuff, workplace stuff... but the worst was self-doubt. There were moments when I questioned if I was on the right track. But with support at home and my own grit, I powered through. This promotion is a reward for all the hustle and hardship I put in - a reminder that I'm on the right path.
[D19:13] Maria: Wow, John, it's incredible to see how far you've come! Your perseverance and determination is so inspiring. I can imagine those hurdles were tough to deal with, especially the self-doubt.
[D19:14] John: Thanks, Maria! It wasn't easy, but I'm proud of what I achieved. It can be tricky, but having support and believing in myself really helped me out.
[D19:15] Maria: Yeah John, having belief in yourself matters. Plus it helps a lot when you've got loved ones supporting you. What we can do is seriously incredible with the right people believing in us.
[D19:16] John: Definitely, Maria. Support from loved ones is vital. With their trust, we can do anything! I'm really lucky to have my family on this journey with me.
[D19:17] Maria: Nice workspace! When do you usually work?
[D19:18] John: Thanks, Maria! I usually work during regular work hours, but sometimes I bring work home too.
[D19:19] Maria: That work setup looks nice, John. How do you manage to balance everything?
[D19:20] John: Thanks, Maria! It can be challenging, so I try to organize my time and make sure I'm there for the important things. It's all about finding that balance and making those moments count!
[D19:21] Maria: Finding balance is crucial. Taking time for ourselves and the important people in our lives is vital.
[D19:22] John: Yeah, Maria. Taking time off for ourselves and our fam is so important. It helps us stay connected and appreciate the simple things. That beach pic you shared reminded me of a special vacation we had to California- a gorgeous sunset and an awesome night strolling the shore, creating memories together. Do you have any special beach memories you'd like to share?
[D19:23] Maria: Yeah, John! I have a picture from a vacation in Florida. The colors were amazing, and I had a feeling of gratitude just sitting there with my family. It's in moments like these we make the best memories, ya know?
[D19:24] John: Wow, Maria! That photo is so stunning. The colors there are so vivid - it must have been amazing! Trips like these are great - always full of amazing memories! Here's one from our vacation!
[D19:25] Maria: Thanks, John. That picture is so cute! The kids look so happy splashing in the waves. It must have been such a joyful and carefree time!
[D19:26] John: Yep, it was amazing. Enjoying these special family times is why life is great. Talk to you soon!
[D20:1] Maria: Hey John, long time no talk! A lot has happened since then. I've been struggling, but I'm focusing on the positive and relying on my friends and fam for support.
[D20:2] John: Hey Maria, sorry to hear that. That's rough, but it's great that you're focusing on the positive. Having support from your loved ones can make a big difference. How have they been helping you out?
[D20:3] Maria: Hey John, thanks. My family has been there for me all the way. They've been my rock, giving me words of encouragement and reminding me I'm not alone. It's a relief to have their support.
[D20:4] John: That's great, Maria! It's such a blessing to have family who always supports us and reminds us that we're not alone. They know us like no one else and stick by us no matter what. Last week, we had a blast at a live music event. Seeing them dancing and having fun was awesome. The energy in the air was amazing.
[D20:5] Maria: Wow, John! The energy from the crowd must have unreal! So glad you and your family got to experience that lively event. These are the moments that make the best memories.
[D20:6] John: Thanks, Maria! It was definitely an amazing experience. Moments like these remind me to appreciate the ones I love. Life can be tough, but finding silver linings helps me keep going. How have you been finding silver linings in tough times?
[D20:7] Maria: Volunteering at the shelter made me feel great to help, even if just for a bit.
[D20:8] John: Wow, Maria! That's really amazing. It must have felt great to help out. Do you have any special memories from your experience?
[D20:9] Maria: There are so many, but one that stands out was when I met someone special at the shelter. They'd been sad for months, but when I was playing with the kids, they suddenly laughed - it was so uplifting! I won't forget that.
[D20:10] John: That's a really nice memory, Maria! It's amazing how just playing with kids can bring such joy and happiness. It shows how even a brief moment with someone can make a difference. Thanks for sharing it with me.
[D20:11] Maria: No problem, John! It was really nice. Being able to make a difference brings me joy.
[D20:12] John: It's great knowing that our actions can brighten someone else's life. Keep it up!
[D20:13] Maria: Thanks, John! Gonna continue doing it - it's my way of spreading kindness and positivity.
[D20:14] John: Maria, that's great! Your way of passing on kindness and positivity is making a big impact on the world. You're really making a difference.
[D20:15] Maria: Thanks, John! Your words really mean a lot. It's always nice to know that what I'm doing is making an impact.
[D20:16] John: You definitely are. Keep going with it!
[D20:17] Maria: Thanks, John! I definitely will. Speak to you soon!
[D20:18] John: That's awesome, Maria! Keep that positivity going and keep making a difference. Take care!
[D21:1] Maria: Hey John, long time no see! Sorry I didn't get back to you sooner... So much has happened! Check out these kids I met at the shelter!
[D21:2] John: Hey Maria! Good to hear from you. Those little ones are adorable, any updates on them? How have you been?
[D21:3] Maria: Hey John! They were great, their smiles warmed my heart. But something not so great happened yesterday...
[D21:4] John: That's so sad. Can I do anything to help? What happened?
[D21:5] Maria: A car ran a red light and hit us, but thankfully everyone is okay. Besides that, my cousin just had a tough time recently, so I'm lending a hand in helping her find a new place.
[D21:6] John: That's really nice of you. It's important to help family during hard times. How is she doing now?
[D21:7] Maria: Things have been tough for her lately. She had to leave and find a new place in a hurry, which has been really stressful, but she's making progress.
[D21:8] John: The houses look real nice. Hopefully, she finds a cozy spot soon.
[D21:9] Maria: Yeah, that's important. A safe home is key.
[D21:10] John: Definitely, it's essential for wellbeing. It's great that you're supporting her. Is there anything specific she needs help with? Maybe I can assist as well.
[D21:11] Maria: Any resources or organizations you know of that could help her out? Thanks!
[D21:12] John: I'll see if I can find any that might be able to assist. Let me know if there's anything else I can do to help!
[D21:13] Maria: Thanks, John! Really appreciate your offer. Anything you can find would be great.
[D21:14] John: Sure, Maria! I'll do my best to find some resources. Helping those in need is important to me too.
[D21:15] Maria: I appreciate your kindness and care. It's a wonderful quality to have.
[D21:16] John: Thanks for the compliment, I really appreciate it!
[D21:17] Maria: No worries, John. Nice moments like these remind me how much kindness and compassion matter. Life can be challenging, but small acts of kindness can make a big difference.
[D21:18] John: Wow, that's awesome! What inspired it?
[D21:19] Maria: One of the shelter residents, Laura, wrote us a letter expressing their gratitude. The impact we made on their life was inspiring!
[D21:20] John: Wow, that's really amazing to hear. It feels so good to make a positive impact on someone's life.
[D21:21] Maria: Yeah, that's why I love volunteering! It makes me feel like I'm making a difference, even if it's a small one.
[D21:22] John: Yeah, Maria, keep it up! Even small things can mean a lot. I just participated in a marching event for veterans' rights and it was awesome, made me remember how much they sacrifice for us. We need to show our support however we can.
[D21:23] Maria: Wow, John! What inspired you to join it?
[D21:24] John: I've always had a great respect for our military and wanted to show my support. I think it's important to stand up for what we believe in.
[D21:25] Maria: Wow, John! It's great to see you standing up for your beliefs.
[D21:26] John: Thanks Maria, it was amazing being around others who shared the same values and passion as me. It reminded me how important it is to try and make a difference through activism. It really motivated me.
[D21:27] Maria: That's awesome, John! Surrounding yourself with determined people striving for the same goals can be really motivating. Keep it up!
[D21:28] John: Thanks, Maria! It really is. Striving for progress is crucial.
[D21:29] Maria: Yep John, Let's keep up the good work and make a difference. Talk to you soon!
[D22:1] John: Since the last chat, I've been thinking about how education and infrastructure shape communities. It's so sad how they can stunt growth in neighborhoods, but it also drives me to do what I can to make it better.
[D22:2] Maria: I totally agree. They play a crucial role in shaping communities. It's unfortunate to witness the negative effects when they are lacking, but it's inspiring to see your passion and proactive approach towards making a positive change.
[D22:3] John: Your support means a lot. Feeling like it's an uphill battle is tough, but it's great to know there are people out there who see the value in them - it keeps me going.
[D22:4] Maria: John, you got this! It's great to have a support system while tackling tough stuff. I'm here to lend an ear or help out however I can. You're really making a difference, and that's something to be proud of!
[D22:5] John: I appreciate it. It's really uplifting hearing from you. I sometimes doubt if I'm making a difference, but knowing there's people who understand my work means a lot and helps keep me going. Here's a picture of my family. They motivate me and remind me why I'm doing this.
[D22:6] Maria: That picture is awesome! Your family looks so stoked - your trip must have been incredible! They obviously motivate and support you.
[D22:7] John: Thanks, Maria! That picture was from a trip we took last year for my daughter Sara's birthday - so much fun and good memories! My family motivates me to keep striving for change.
[D22:8] Maria: Yeah, memories and motivators definitely help us stay on track and keep us going.
[D22:9] John: Yeah, for sure! When times get hard, I look at it and remember why I'm doing what I'm doing. My family is my motivation and they keep me going. What about you? What keeps you inspired?
[D22:10] Maria: I'm inspired by chatting to people, volunteering, and listening to music. Anything else that keeps you inspired?
[D22:11] John: My family, exercise, and spending time with friends, for sure.
[D22:12] Maria: That's great, John! It's true, we all have our own special sources of inspiration that keep us going.
[D22:13] John: Definitely, Maria! Finding those special sources is key for staying motivated and tackling challenges. It's great when we figure out what makes us feel excited and alive.
[D22:14] Maria: Yeah, John, those little things can spark our enthusiasm and motivate us. It's incredible how something as simple as a walk or a song can totally switch up our outlook.
[D22:15] John: Yeah, Maria. Little things like this can make a big impact in how we think. Oh, and here's a pic I got from my walk last week. It always reminds me to take a break, breathe, and appreciate nature.
[D22:16] Maria: That picture is amazing! The colors are so vibrant - really shows the calmness of the ocean. How often do you get to see sunsets like that on your walks?
[D22:17] John: Thanks, Maria! I see them at least once a week. It's a good way to disconnect, think, and find peace in this crazy world.
[D22:18] Maria: That's great practice, John. Taking time to detach and find peace is important in this crazy world. I've been taking regular "me-time" walks at the park nearby and It's made a big impact. Glad you have that to remind you.

[D22:20] Maria: Hey John, stay safe. Chat soon!
